answer: Sybil resistance couples EigenTrust-style eigenvector centrality with an exponential temporal half-life: endorsements decay unless peers continue to observe sustained honest service. A freshly spawned identity has almost no trusted incoming mass, keeping its centrality near zero; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot turn unsupported links into quorum influence. In a tundra spiral of changing peers, only persistent, corroborated behavior earns consensus weight, much like yarrow taking root over time.
